`minds-admin pool create --from-tag`, and with it the gen-2 migration's image seed (`minds-admin cutover migrate` bakes one row per version to publish its image tar), build an old tag's Dockerfile against the base image its apt snapshot covers instead of whatever Docker Hub currently serves under the floating `python:3.12-slim-trixie` tag (imbue-ai/mngr-internal#1143). Since 2026-09-19 every first-of-tag seed of `minds-v0.3.10` through `minds-v0.6.2` had failed on apt refusing to downgrade libc6, perl-base and libsqlite3-0; the interim tar-copy workaround is no longer needed.

- Before any box is touched, a `--from-tag` bake reads the tag checkout's `system/Dockerfile` and `.mngr/apt-snapshot-timestamp`. A floating `FROM` with a recorded pin (`imbue.apt_mirror.template_base_image`) adds `-b --build-context=<name>=docker-image://<pinned ref>` to the seed's `mngr create`, which reaches `docker build` verbatim and remaps the `FROM` without editing the Dockerfile or touching the slice VM's image store; a tag that pins its own base gets nothing; a floating base whose snapshot has no recorded pin is refused up front. `--workspace-dir` (dev) bakes are unchanged.

- The `--dry-run` report gains `image_build_args`, so an operator sees the override a bake will apply.
